tools.name: hlidac_compare_savings
tools.description:
Rank Czech savings accounts (spořicí účty) by the effective interest rate (úrok, sazba) for a given deposit, with the net yield after the 15 % tax.

tools.name: hlidac_compare_term_deposits
tools.description:
Rank Czech term deposits (termínované vklady) for a deposit and a term (délka v měsících) by the rate (úrok, sazba), with the net yield for the whole term after the 15 % tax.
